Now that I think about it, the only grandchildren Ronald Reagan had (who still kept the last name) was Cameron Michael Reagan (born 1978) and Ashley Reagan (born 1983). 

I am not sure if Ashley would keep the last name if she got married, and there was no mention of Cameron having any children.

so it is possible Christopher can exist if Ashley or Cameron had children (and Ashley divorced shortly before Chris is born), or Cameron marries and has kids before he's like 45-50 or something. Christopher can be a clone of Ronald Reagan (which would be an interesting option), or he can exist through adoption (again), but it would have to be from either Ashley or Cameron Reagan.
